Based on standard GitHub practices and typical NousResearch repository guidelines (as a specific security policy document is not provided):

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (Preferred):** Go to the repository at [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent), click on the **Security** tab, and select **"Report a vulnerability"** to submit an advisory privately.
2. **Direct Contact:** If private vulnerability reporting is not enabled, reach out directly to the Nous Research team/maintainers (via their official Discord server or maintainer contact emails) rather than opening a public issue.
